This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: **/*.cs, **/*.json, **/Dockerfile, **/.dockerignore, **/*.ts, **/*.tsx, **/*.html
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/Properties/**, **/wwwroot/**, **/logs/**, **/bin/**, **/obj/**, **/.vs/**, **/.vscode/**, **/TestResults/**, **/*.user, **/*.suo, **/AppPackages/**, **/BundleArtifacts/**, **/dist/**, **/node_modules/**, **/Migrations/**, **/appsettings.Development.json, **/appsettings.Local.json, repomix-output.txt, repomix.config.json, **/*.sql, **/*.cshtml, **/*.sln, **/*.md, **/*.csproj
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 5: 
 6: /// <summary>
 7: /// EF surface used by ingestion queries/commands so handlers stay testable and persistence stays in Infrastructure.
 8: /// </summary>
 9: public interface IIngestionDbContext
10: {
11:     DbSet<Topic> Topics { get; }
12:     DbSet<Source> Sources { get; }
13:     DbSet<ArticleMetadata> ArticlesMetadata { get; }
14:     DbSet<ArticleContent> ArticlesContent { get; }
15:     DbSet<ArticleTopic> ArticleTopics { get; }
16:     DbSet<IngestionRun> IngestionRuns { get; }
17: 
18:     Task<int> SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
19: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler.cs
================
  1: using MediatR;
  2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
  5: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
  6: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  7: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
  8: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  9: 
 10: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
 11: 
 12: public sealed class PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler(
 13:     IIngestionDbContext db,
 14:     ILogger<PersistIngestedArticlesCommandHandler> logger)
 15:     : IRequestHandler<PersistIngestedArticlesCommand, int>
 16: {
 17:     public async Task<int> Handle(PersistIngestedArticlesCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 18:     {
 19:         if (request.Items.Count == 0)
 20:             return 0;
 21: 
 22:         var totalSaved = 0;
 23:         var chunkSize = IngestionPipelineConstants.ArticlePersistChunkSize;
 24: 
 25:         for (var i = 0; i < request.Items.Count; i += chunkSize)
 26:         {
 27:             var chunk = request.Items.Skip(i).Take(chunkSize).ToList();
 28:             var pairs = new List<(ArticleMetadata Meta, RssFeedItemDto Dto)>();
 29: 
 30:             foreach (var dto in chunk)
 31:             {
 32:                 try
 33:                 {
 34:                     var meta = CreateArticleMetadata(request.SourceId, request.DefaultLanguageCode, dto);
 35:                     pairs.Add((meta, dto));
 36:                     db.ArticlesMetadata.Add(meta);
 37:                 }
 38:                 catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
 39:                 {
 40:                     logger.LogError(ex, "Error building article entity for external id: {ExternalId}", dto.ExternalId);
 41:                 }
 42:             }
 43: 
 44:             if (pairs.Count == 0)
 45:                 continue;
 46: 
 47:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 48:             await AppendArticleTopicsAsync(pairs, cancellationToken);
 49:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 50: 
 51:             foreach (var (_, dto) in pairs)
 52:                 logger.LogInformation("Ingested new article: {Title}", dto.Title);
 53: 
 54:             totalSaved += pairs.Count;
 55:         }
 56: 
 57:         return totalSaved;
 58:     }
 59: 
 60:     private static ArticleMetadata CreateArticleMetadata(int sourceId, string defaultLanguageCode, RssFeedItemDto dto)
 61:     {
 62:         var articleMeta = new ArticleMetadata
 63:         {
 64:             SourceId = sourceId,
 65:             ExternalId = dto.ExternalId,
 66:             Title = dto.Title,
 67:             Author = dto.Author,
 68:             Url = dto.Link,
 69:             ImageTag = dto.ImageTag,
 70:             PublishedAt = dto.PublishedDate,
 71:             IngestedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
 72:             LanguageCode = defaultLanguageCode,
 73:             RegionCode = "Global",
 74:             IsActive = true,
 75:             SummaryShort = dto.Description,
 76:             PositivityScore = dto.PositivityScore,
 77:             AnalyzedAt = dto.PositivityScore.HasValue ? DateTime.UtcNow : null
 78:         };
 79: 
 80:         articleMeta.Content = new ArticleContent
 81:         {
 82:             ContentRaw = dto.ContentRaw,
 83:             ContentClean = dto.ContentClean
 84:         };
 85: 
 86:         return articleMeta;
 87:     }
 88: 
 89:     private async Task AppendArticleTopicsAsync(
 90:         IReadOnlyList<(ArticleMetadata Meta, RssFeedItemDto Dto)> pairs,
 91:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 92:     {
 93:         var names = pairs
 94:             .SelectMany(p => p.Dto.Topics ?? Enumerable.Empty<string>())
 95:             .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 96:             .ToList();
 97: 
 98:         if (names.Count == 0)
 99:             return;
100: 
101:         var topicIdByName = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
102:         foreach (var nameChunk in names.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
103:         {
104:             var arr = nameChunk.ToArray();
105:             var rows = await db.Topics
106:                 .AsNoTracking()
107:                 .Where(t => arr.Contains(t.Name))
108:                 .Select(t => new { t.Id, t.Name })
109:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
110: 
111:             foreach (var row in rows)
112:                 topicIdByName[row.Name] = row.Id;
113:         }
114: 
115:         foreach (var (meta, dto) in pairs)
116:         {
117:             if (dto.Topics == null || dto.Topics.Count == 0)
118:                 continue;
119: 
120:             var seenTopicIds = new HashSet<int>();
121:             foreach (var topicName in dto.Topics)
122:             {
123:                 if (!topicIdByName.TryGetValue(topicName, out var topicId) || !seenTopicIds.Add(topicId))
124:                     continue;
125: 
126:                 db.ArticleTopics.Add(new ArticleTopic
127:                 {
128:                     ArticleId = meta.Id,
129:                     TopicId = topicId
130:                 });
131:             }
132:         }
133:     }
134: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler.cs
================
  1: using MediatR;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
  5: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  6: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  7: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
  8: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  9: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 10: using System.Diagnostics;
 11: 
 12: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
 13: 
 14: public sealed class ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler(
 15:     IIngestionDbContext db,
 16:     IFeedReader feedReader,
 17:     IFeedProcessor feedProcessor,
 18:     IMediator mediator,
 19:     ILogger<ProcessIngestionSourceCommandHandler> logger)
 20:     : IRequestHandler<ProcessIngestionSourceCommand>
 21: {
 22:     public async Task Handle(ProcessIngestionSourceCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 23:     {
 24:         var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
 25:         var source = request.Source;
 26:         logger.LogInformation("Processing source: {SourceName} ({FeedUrl})", source.Name, source.FeedUrl);
 27: 
 28:         var run = new IngestionRun
 29:         {
 30:             SourceId = source.Id,
 31:             StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
 32:             Status = IngestionStatus.Running
 33:         };
 34:         db.IngestionRuns.Add(run);
 35:         await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 36: 
 37:         var newArticleCount = 0;
 38:         var url = source.FeedUrl;
 39: 
 40:         try
 41:         {
 42:             var doc = await feedReader.ReadFeedAsync(url, cancellationToken);
 43:             var processingResult = feedProcessor.ProcessFeed(url, doc, request.TopicLookup, cancellationToken);
 44:             var dtoItems = processingResult.Items;
 45:             var invalidCount = processingResult.InvalidCount;
 46: 
 47:             var skipCount = invalidCount;
 48: 
 49:             if (dtoItems.Count == 0)
 50:             {
 51:                 logger.LogWarning("Source {SourceName} returned zero feed items.", source.Name);
 52:                 run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
 53:                 run.ErrorMessage = "Feed returned zero items. The feed URL may be unavailable or empty.";
 54:                 run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
 55:                 await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 56:                 return;
 57:             }
 58: 
 59:             var existingKeys = await mediator.Send(
 60:                 new FindExistingArticleKeysQuery(
 61:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.ExternalId).ToList(),
 62:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.Link).ToList(),
 63:                     dtoItems.Select(d => d.Title).ToList()),
 64:                 cancellationToken);
 65: 
 66:             var toPersist = new List<RssFeedItemDto>();
 67:             var pendingExternalIds = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 68:             var pendingUrls = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 69:             var pendingTitles = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 70: 
 71:             foreach (var item in dtoItems)
 72:             {
 73:                 cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
 74: 
 75:                 if (existingKeys.Matches(item))
 76:                 {
 77:                     logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate: {Title}", item.Title);
 78:                     skipCount++;
 79:                     continue;
 80:                 }
 81: 
 82:                 if (ConflictsWithPendingBatch(item, pendingExternalIds, pendingUrls, pendingTitles))
 83:                 {
 84:                     logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate within feed: {Title}", item.Title);
 85:                     skipCount++;
 86:                     continue;
 87:                 }
 88: 
 89:                 if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ExternalId))
 90:                     pendingExternalIds.Add(item.ExternalId);
 91:                 pendingUrls.Add(item.Link);
 92:                 pendingTitles.Add(item.Title);
 93:                 toPersist.Add(item);
 94:             }
 95: 
 96:             newArticleCount = await mediator.Send(
 97:                 new PersistIngestedArticlesCommand(source.Id, source.DefaultLanguageCode, toPersist),
 98:                 cancellationToken);
 99: 
100:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Success;
101:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
102:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
103:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
104: 
105:             logger.LogInformation(
106:                 "Source {SourceName}: ingested {NewCount} new articles out of {TotalCount} feed items. {SkipCount} rejected.",
107:                 source.Name,
108:                 newArticleCount,
109:                 dtoItems.Count + invalidCount,
110:                 skipCount);
111:         }
112:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
113:         {
114:             logger.LogWarning("Ingestion for {SourceName} was cancelled.", source.Name);
115:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
116:             run.ErrorMessage = "Operation was cancelled.";
117:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
118:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
119:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
120:         }
121:         catch (Exception ex)
122:         {
123:             logger.LogError(ex, "Error ingesting source {SourceName}.", source.Name);
124:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Failed;
125:             run.ErrorMessage = ex.Message.Length > 4000 ? ex.Message[..4000] : ex.Message;
126:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
127:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
128:             await db.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
129:         }
130:         finally
131:         {
132:             stopwatch.Stop();
133:             logger.LogInformation(
134:                 "Processing source {SourceName} finished in {ElapsedMs} ms.",
135:                 source.Name,
136:                 stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
137:         }
138:     }
139: 
140:     private static bool ConflictsWithPendingBatch(
141:         RssFeedItemDto item,
142:         HashSet<string> pendingExternalIds,
143:         HashSet<string> pendingUrls,
144:         HashSet<string> pendingTitles)
145:     {
146:         if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.ExternalId) && pendingExternalIds.Contains(item.ExternalId))
147:             return true;
148:         if (pendingUrls.Contains(item.Link))
149:             return true;
150:         return pendingTitles.Contains(item.Title);
151:     }
152: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/CommandHandlers/Ingestion/RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 7: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Application.CommandHandlers.Ingestion;
10: 
11: public sealed class RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler : IRequestHandler<RunIngestionCycleCommand>
12: {
13:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
14:     private readonly ILogger<RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler> _logger;
15: 
16:     public RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler(
17:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
18:         ILogger<RunIngestionCycleCommandHandler> logger)
19:     {
20:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
21:         _logger = logger;
22:     }
23: 
24:     public async Task Handle(RunIngestionCycleCommand request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
25:     {
26:         _logger.LogInformation("---=== Ingestion cycle started. ===---");
27: 
28:         TopicLookup topicLookup;
29:         IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot> activeSources;
30: 
31:         // This scope fetches the topics and active sources. Once it fetches them, it closes.
32:         // This ensures the database connection used for this quick read is released immediately
33:         using (var initialScope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope())
34:         {
35:             var mediator = initialScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
36:             topicLookup = await mediator.Send(new GetTopicLookupQuery(), cancellationToken);
37:             _logger.LogInformation("Topic lookup built with {Count} topics.", topicLookup.ByName.Count);
38:             activeSources = await mediator.Send(new GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery(), cancellationToken);
39:         }
40: 
41:         _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} active sources with feed URLs.", activeSources.Count);
42: 
43:         foreach (var source in activeSources)
44:         {
45:             if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
46:                 break;
47: 
48:             // Get a brand - new, clean database connection for each news site.
49:             // If one fails, the others may succeed, and memory is cleared after each loop.
50:             using var sourceScope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
51:             var mediator = sourceScope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
52:             await mediator.Send(new ProcessIngestionSourceCommand(source, topicLookup), cancellationToken);
53: 
54:             if (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
55:             {
56:                 _logger.LogDebug("Waiting {Delay} before next source...", 
57:                     IngestionPipelineConstants.DelayBetweenSources);
58:                 await Task.Delay(IngestionPipelineConstants.DelayBetweenSources, cancellationToken);
59:             }
60:         }
61: 
62:         _logger.LogInformation("=== Ingestion cycle completed. ===");
63:     }
64: }

File: PositiveNews.Application/DependencyInjection.cs

 1: using System.Reflection;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Application;
 5: 
 6: /// <summary>
 7: /// Clean Registration Pattern for the Application layer.
 8: /// </summary>
 9: public static class DependencyInjection
10: {
11:     public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services)
12:     {
13:         services.AddMediatR(cfg =>
14:             cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssembly(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly()));
15: 
16:         return services;
17:     }
18: }

 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs.Articles;

 3: public sealed class ArticleDetailDto
 4: {
 5:     public long Id { get; init; }
 6:     public string Title { get; init; } = string.Empty;
 7:     public string SourceName { get; init; } = string.Empty;
 8:     public string? SourceLogoUrl { get; init; }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/DTOs/ExistingArticleKeys.cs
================
 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 2: 
 3: /// <summary>
 4: /// Keys already present in storage, used to skip duplicates without per-item queries.
 5: /// </summary>
 6: public sealed class ExistingArticleKeys
 7: {
 8:     public HashSet<string> ExternalIds { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
 9:     public HashSet<string> Urls { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
10:     public HashSet<string> Titles { get; } = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
11: 
12:     public bool Matches(RssFeedItemDto dto) =>
13:         (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dto.ExternalId) && ExternalIds.Contains(dto.ExternalId))
14:         || Urls.Contains(dto.Link)
15:         || Titles.Contains(dto.Title);
16: }

File: PositiveNews.Application/DTOs/RssFeedItemDto.cs

 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 2: 
 3: /// <summary>
 4: /// Represents a single item parsed from an RSS feed.
 5: /// This DTO is source-agnostic and carries only the data the ingestion pipeline needs.
 6: /// </summary>
 7: public class RssFeedItemDto
 8: {
 9:     public string Title { get; set; } = string.Empty;
10:     public string Link { get; init; } = string.Empty;
11: 
12:     public string ContentRaw { get; set; } = string.Empty;
13:     public string Description { get; set; } = string.Empty;
14:     public string? Author { get; init; }
15:     public string? ContentClean { get; set; }
16: 
17:     public DateTime PublishedDate { get; init; }
18: 
19:     public string? ExternalId { get; init; }
20:     public string? ImageTag { get; set; }
21: 
22:     public List<string> Topics { get; set; } = [];
23:     public decimal? PositivityScore { get; set; }
24: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/DTOs/TopicLookup.cs
================
 1: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 2: 
 3: namespace PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 4: 
 5: public record TopicLookup
 6: {
 7:     public Dictionary<string, Topic> ByName { get; set; } = [];
 8:     public Dictionary<string, List<Topic>> BySlugWord { get; set; } = [];
 9:     public Dictionary<string, List<Topic>> ChildToParentTopics { get; set; } = [];
10: 
11:     public static TopicLookup Build(IReadOnlyList<Topic> topics)
12:     {
13:         var lookup = new TopicLookup();
14: 
15:         foreach (var topic in topics)
16:         {
17:             lookup.ByName[topic.Name] = topic;
18: 
19:             var slugWords = topic.Slug?
20:                 .Split([',', ';', ' ', '|'], StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
21:                 .Select(w => w.Trim().ToLowerInvariant()) ?? [];
22: 
23:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
24:             {
25:                 if (!lookup.BySlugWord.ContainsKey(word))
26:                     lookup.BySlugWord[word] = [];
27:                 lookup.BySlugWord[word].Add(topic);
28:             }
29: 
30:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
31:             {
32:                 if (!lookup.ChildToParentTopics.ContainsKey(word))
33:                     lookup.ChildToParentTopics[word] = [];
34:                 lookup.ChildToParentTopics[word].Add(topic);
35:             }
36:         }
37: 
38:         return lookup;
39:     }
40: }

File: PositiveNews.Application/Ingestion/IngestionPipelineConstants.cs
================
 1: namespace PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 2: 
 3: public static class IngestionPipelineConstants
 4: {
 5:     public static readonly TimeSpan DelayBetweenSources = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2);
 6: 
 7:     /// <summary>Articles inserted per SaveChanges batch (metadata + content, then topics).</summary>
 8:     public const int ArticlePersistChunkSize = 25;
 9: 
10:     /// <summary>SQL Server parameter budget — split IN clauses when lists are large.</summary>
11:     public const int SqlInClauseChunkSize = 500;
12: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Articles/GetArticleDetailQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs.Articles;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Articles;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Articles;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class GetArticleDetailQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
10:     : IRequestHandler<GetArticleDetailQuery, ArticleDetailDto?>
11: {
12:     public async Task<ArticleDetailDto?> Handle(GetArticleDetailQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
13:     {
14:         var article = await db.ArticlesMetadata
15:             .Include(a => a.Source)
16:             .Include(a => a.Content)
17:             .AsNoTracking()
18:             .FirstOrDefaultAsync(a => a.Id == request.Id && a.IsActive, cancellationToken);
19: 
20:         if (article == null)
21:         {
22:             return null;
23:         }
24: 
25:         return new ArticleDetailDto
26:         {
27:             Id = article.Id,
28:             Title = article.Title,
29:             SourceName = article.Source.Name,
30:             SourceLogoUrl = article.Source.LogoUrl,
31:             Author = article.Author,
32:             PublishedAt = article.PublishedAt,
33:             ContentHtml = article.Content?.ContentRaw
34:         };
35:     }
36: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Articles/GetArticleFeedQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs.Articles;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Articles;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Articles;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class GetArticleFeedQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
10:     : IRequestHandler<GetArticleFeedQuery, ArticleFeedPageResult>
11: {
12:     public async Task<ArticleFeedPageResult> Handle(GetArticleFeedQuery request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
13:     {
14:         var page = Math.Max(1, request.Page);
15:         var pageSize = Math.Clamp(request.PageSize, 1, 100);
16:         var topic = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Topic) ? null : request.Topic.Trim();
17: 
18:         var query = db.ArticlesMetadata
19:             .Include(a => a.Source)
20:             .Include(a => a.ArticleTopics)
21:                 .ThenInclude(at => at.Topic)
22:             .Where(a => a.IsActive)
23:             .AsNoTracking();
24: 
25:         if (topic != null)
26:         {
27:             query = query
28:                 .OrderByDescending(a => a.ArticleTopics.Any(at => at.Topic!.Name == topic))
29:                 .ThenByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt);
30:         }
31:         else
32:         {
33:             query = query.OrderByDescending(a => a.PublishedAt);
34:         }
35: 
36:         var totalArticles = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);
37:         var totalPages = (int)Math.Ceiling(totalArticles / (double)pageSize);
38: 
39:         var articles = await query
40:             .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
41:             .Take(pageSize)
42:             .Select(a => new ArticleFeedItemDto
43:             {
44:                 Id = a.Id,
45:                 SourceName = a.Source.Name,
46:                 SourceLogoUrl = a.Source.LogoUrl,
47:                 Title = a.Title,
48:                 Author = a.Author,
49:                 PublishedAt = a.PublishedAt,
50:                 ImageTag = a.ImageTag,
51:                 SummaryShort = a.SummaryShort ?? "No summary available.",
52:                 Topics = a.ArticleTopics
53:                     .Where(at => at.Topic != null)
54:                     .Select(at => at.Topic!.Name)
55:                     .ToList()
56:             })
57:             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
58: 
59:         return new ArticleFeedPageResult
60:         {
61:             Articles = articles,
62:             CurrentPage = page,
63:             TotalPages = totalPages,
64:             PageSize = pageSize,
65:             SelectedTopic = topic
66:         };
67:     }
68: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Articles/GetTopicFilterListQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Articles;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Articles;
 7: 
 8: public sealed class GetTopicFilterListQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
 9:     : IRequestHandler<GetTopicFilterListQuery, IReadOnlyList<string>>

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Ingestion/FindExistingArticleKeysQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Ingestion;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 7: 
 8: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Ingestion;
 9: 
10: public sealed class FindExistingArticleKeysQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
11:     : IRequestHandler<FindExistingArticleKeysQuery, ExistingArticleKeys>
12: {
13:     public async Task<ExistingArticleKeys> Handle(
14:         FindExistingArticleKeysQuery request,
15:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
16:     {
17:         var result = new ExistingArticleKeys();
18: 
19:         var extDistinct = request.ExternalIds
20:             .Where(x => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(x))
21:             .Distinct()
22:             .ToList();
23: 
24:         foreach (var chunk in extDistinct.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
25:         {
26:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
27:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
28:                 .Where(a => a.ExternalId != null && chunkArr.Contains(a.ExternalId))
29:                 .Select(a => a.ExternalId!)
30:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
31:             foreach (var id in batch)
32:                 result.ExternalIds.Add(id);
33:         }
34: 
35:         var urls = request.Urls.Distinct().ToList();
36:         foreach (var chunk in urls.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
37:         {
38:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
39:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
40:                 .Where(a => chunkArr.Contains(a.Url))
41:                 .Select(a => a.Url)
42:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
43:             foreach (var u in batch)
44:                 result.Urls.Add(u);
45:         }
46: 
47:         var titles = request.Titles.Distinct().ToList();
48:         foreach (var chunk in titles.Chunk(IngestionPipelineConstants.SqlInClauseChunkSize))
49:         {
50:             var chunkArr = chunk.ToArray();
51:             var batch = await db.ArticlesMetadata.AsNoTracking()
52:                 .Where(a => chunkArr.Contains(a.Title))
53:                 .Select(a => a.Title)
54:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
55:             foreach (var t in batch)
56:                 result.Titles.Add(t);
57:         }
58: 
59:         return result;
60:     }
61: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Application/QueryHandlers/Ingestion/GetActiveIngestionSourcesQueryHandler.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Ingestion;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Application.QueryHandlers.Ingestion;
 8: 
 9: public sealed class GetActiveIngestionSourcesQueryHandler(IIngestionDbContext db)
10:     : IRequestHandler<GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery, IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot>>
11: {
12:     public async Task<IReadOnlyList<IngestionSourceSnapshot>> Handle(
13:         GetActiveIngestionSourcesQuery request,
14:         CancellationToken cancellationToken)
15:     {
16:         return await db.Sources
17:             .AsNoTracking()
18:             .Where(s => s.IsActive && s.FeedUrl != null)
19:             .OrderBy(s => s.Id)
20:             .Select(s => new IngestionSourceSnapshot(s.Id, s.Name, s.FeedUrl!, s.DefaultLanguageCode))
21:             .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
22:     }
23: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/IngestionBackgroundService.cs
================
 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 5: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 6: using PositiveNews.Application.Commands.Ingestion;
 7: using static Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.DbLoggerCategory.Database;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
10: 
11: /// <summary>
12: /// A long-running hosted service that periodically triggers the ingestion cycle.
13: /// Interval is configurable via "Ingestion:IntervalMinutes" in appsettings.json.
14: /// </summary>
15: public class IngestionBackgroundService : BackgroundService // ← Implements IHostedService
16: {
17:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
18:     private readonly ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> _logger;
19:     private readonly TimeSpan _interval;
20: 
21:     /// <summary>
22:     /// Initial delay before the first run so the application has time to fully start.
23:     /// </summary>
24:     private static readonly TimeSpan _initialDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(3);
25: 
26:     public IngestionBackgroundService(   // Host Creates instances of IngestionBackgroundService when starts
27:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, // This service added to ASP .NET IoC by default. Needed for creation scope in singleton
28:         ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> logger,
29:         IConfiguration configuration)
30:     {
31:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
32:         _logger = logger;
33: 
34:         // Can't inject MediatR in class constructor because they have different lifecycle
35: 
36:         // Read interval from appsettings.json
37:         var minutes = configuration.GetValue<int>("Ingestion:IntervalMinutes", 60);
38:         _interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(minutes);
39:     }
40: 
41:     // THIS METHOD IS CALLED AUTOMATICALLY BY ASP.NET CORE WHEN HOST STARTS
42:     // ASP.NET Core host calls ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken) for each service after app.RunAsync() in programm.cs
43:     // because of BackgroundService implement IHostedService
44:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
45:     {
46:         _logger.LogInformation(
47:             "Ingestion Background Service started. Interval: {Interval}. Initial delay: {Delay}.",
48:             _interval, _initialDelay);
49: 
50:         // Wait for the application to fully initialize before the first run.
51:         await Task.Delay(_initialDelay, stoppingToken);
52: 
53:         try
54:         {
55:             while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested) // Infinite loop until app stops
56:             {
57: 
58:                 // This wraps the entire ingestion cycle. It creates a safe boundary and trigger the main
59:                 // Command Handler without polluting the Singleton host.
60:                 using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
61:                 var mediator = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IMediator>();
62: 
63:                 await mediator.Send(new RunIngestionCycleCommand(), stoppingToken);
64: 
65:                 // Wait for the configured interval before the next run.
66:                 if (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
67:                 {
68:                     _logger.LogInformation("Next ingestion cycle in {Interval}.", _interval);
69:                     await Task.Delay(_interval, stoppingToken);
70:                 }
71:             }
72:         }
73:         catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
74:         {
75:             _logger.LogInformation("Ingestion Background Service is stopping.");
76:         }
77:         catch (Exception ex)
78:         {
79:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception in ingestion cycle. Will retry after interval.");
80:         }
81:     }
82: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 6: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
 7: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
 8: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 9: 
10: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure;
11: 
12: /// <summary>
13: /// Clean Registration Pattern for the Infrastructure layer.
14: /// Call this single method from WebApi's Program.cs.
15: /// </summary>
16: public static class DependencyInjection
17: {
18:     public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructureServices(
19:         this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
20:     {
21:         // EF Core with SQL Server
22:         var connectionString = ConnectionStringResolver.Resolve(configuration);
23: 
24:         services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
25:                options.UseSqlServer(connectionString, sqlOptions =>
26:                       {
27:                           sqlOptions.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly.FullName);
28:                           sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3);
29:                       }));
30: 
31:         services.AddScoped<IIngestionDbContext>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>());
32: 
33:         // HttpClient for RSS feed fetching.
34:         // Configured with a polite User-Agent and a reasonable timeout.
35:         services.AddHttpClient("RssFeedClient", client =>
36:      {
37:          client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
38:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.ParseAdd(
39:             "PositiveNews/1.0 (+https://github.com/positivenews; Academic Project)");
40:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.ParseAdd("application/rss+xml, application/xml, text/xml");
41:      });
42: 
43:         // Application services
44:         services.AddScoped<IFeedReader, FeedReader>();
45:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemValidator, FeedItemValidator>();
46:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemParser, FeedItemParser>();
47:         services.AddScoped<IFeedProcessor, FeedProcessor>();
48:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemCleaner, FeedItemCleaner>();
49:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemEnricher, FeedItemEnricher>();
50:         services.AddScoped<IImgTagExtractor, PreviewImgTagExtractor>();
51:         services.AddScoped<IPositivityAnalyzer, KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer>();
52: 
53:         // Background services
54:         services.AddHostedService<IngestionBackgroundService>();
55: 
56:         return services;
57:     }
58: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/AppDbContext.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.Abstractions.Persistence;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 4: 
 5: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
 6: 
 7: public class AppDbContext : DbContext, IIngestionDbContext
 8: {
 9:     public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options) { }
10: 
11:     // Identity
12:     public DbSet<Role> Roles => Set<Role>();
13:     public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
14:     public DbSet<UserRole> UserRoles => Set<UserRole>();
15:     public DbSet<UserFeedPreference> UserFeedPreferences => Set<UserFeedPreference>();
16:     public DbSet<UserSourceFilter> UserSourceFilters => Set<UserSourceFilter>();
17:     public DbSet<UserTopicFilter> UserTopicFilters => Set<UserTopicFilter>();
18: 
19:     // Catalog
20:     public DbSet<Topic> Topics => Set<Topic>();
21:     public DbSet<Source> Sources => Set<Source>();
22:     public DbSet<ArticleMetadata> ArticlesMetadata => Set<ArticleMetadata>();
23:     public DbSet<ArticleContent> ArticlesContent => Set<ArticleContent>();
24:     public DbSet<ArticleTopic> ArticleTopics => Set<ArticleTopic>();
25:     public DbSet<IngestionRun> IngestionRuns => Set<IngestionRun>();
26: 
27:     // Community
28:     public DbSet<Comment> Comments => Set<Comment>();
29: 
30:     // Admin
31:     public DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs => Set<AuditLog>();
32: 
33:     protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
34:     {
35:         // Applies all IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> from this assembly.
36:         modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly);
37: 
38:         base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
39:     }
40: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleContentConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleContentConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleContent>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleContent> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticlesContent", SchemaNames.Catalog);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(c => c.Id);
15: 
16:         // Id is NOT identity — it shares the value from ArticleMetadata.
17:         builder.Property(c => c.Id).ValueGeneratedNever();
18: 
19:         builder.Property(c => c.ContentRaw).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
20:         builder.Property(c => c.ContentClean).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
21:     }
22: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleMetadataConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleMetadataConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleMetadata>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleMetadata> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticlesMetadata", SchemaNames.Catalog); 
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(a => a.Id);
15:         builder.Property(a => a.ExternalId).HasMaxLength(300);
16:         builder.Property(a => a.Title).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired();
17:         builder.Property(a => a.Author).HasMaxLength(300);
18:         builder.Property(a => a.Url).HasMaxLength(1000).IsRequired();
19:         builder.Property(a => a.ImageTag).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
20:         builder.Property(a => a.PublishedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
21:         builder.Property(a => a.IngestedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
22:         builder.Property(a => a.PositivityScore).HasColumnType("decimal(5,4)");
23:         builder.Property(a => a.ViewCount).HasDefaultValue(0L);
24:         builder.Property(a => a.LanguageCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("und");
25:         builder.Property(a => a.RegionCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("Global");
26:         builder.Property(a => a.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
27:         builder.Property(a => a.SummaryShort).HasMaxLength(2000);
28: 
29:         // Check constraint
30:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
31:             "CK_Articles_Positivity", "[PositivityScore] BETWEEN 0.0000 AND 1.0000"));
32: 
33:         // Deduplication unique index
34:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.SourceId, a.ExternalId })
35:                .IsUnique()
36:                .HasFilter("[ExternalId] IS NOT NULL")
37:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Source_ExternalId");
38: 
39:         // Feed performance index
40:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.LanguageCode, a.RegionCode, a.PublishedAt })
41:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
42:                .HasFilter("[IsActive] = 1")
43:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Feed_Date");
44: 
45:         // Source lookup index
46:         builder.HasIndex(a => a.SourceId)
47:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_SourceId");
48: 
49:         // Relationships
50:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Source)
51:                .WithMany(s => s.Articles)
52:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.SourceId)
53:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
54: 
55:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Moderator)
56:                .WithMany()
57:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.ModeratedBy)
58:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
59: 
60:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Content)
61:                .WithOne(c => c.Metadata)
62:                .HasForeignKey<ArticleContent>(c => c.Id)
63:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
64:     }
65: }

File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleTopicConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleTopicConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleTopic>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleTopic> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticleTopics", SchemaNames.Catalog);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(at => new { at.ArticleId, at.TopicId });
15: 
16:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Article)
17:                .WithMany(a => a.ArticleTopics)
18:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.ArticleId)
19:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
20: 
21:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Topic)
22:                .WithMany(t => t.ArticleTopics)
23:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.TopicId)
24:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
25: 
26:         // Reverse lookup index
27:         builder.HasIndex(at => at.TopicId)
28:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticleTopics_Topic_Lookup");
29:     }
30: }

File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/AuditLogConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 8: 
 9: public class AuditLogConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<AuditLog>
10: {
11:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<AuditLog> builder)
12:     {
13:         builder.ToTable("AuditLogs", SchemaNames.Admin);
14: 
15:         builder.HasKey(al => al.Id);
16: 
17:         builder.Property(al => al.EntityType)
18:                .HasMaxLength(50)
19:                .HasConversion<string>();
20: 
21:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
22:             "CK_Audit_Entity", "[EntityType] IN ('Article', 'Comment', 'User', 'Source')"));
23: 
24:         builder.Property(al => al.ChangedField).HasMaxLength(100);
25:         builder.Property(al => al.OldValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
26:         builder.Property(al => al.NewValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
27:         builder.Property(al => al.Reason).HasMaxLength(500);
28:         builder.Property(al => al.Note).HasMaxLength(1000);
29:         builder.Property(al => al.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
30: 
31:         builder.HasOne(al => al.Moderator)
32:                .WithMany()
33:                .HasForeignKey(al => al.ModeratorId)
34:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
35: 
36:         // History lookup index
37:         builder.HasIndex(al => new { al.EntityType, al.EntityId, al.CreatedAt })
38:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
39:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_AuditLogs_Entity_History");
40:     }
41: }

File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/CommentConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class CommentConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Comment>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Comment> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("Comments", SchemaNames.Community);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(c => c.Id);
15:         builder.Property(c => c.Content).HasMaxLength(2000).IsRequired();
16:         builder.Property(c => c.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
17:         builder.Property(c => c.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
18: 
19:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Article)
20:                .WithMany(a => a.Comments)
21:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ArticleId)
22:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
23: 
24:         builder.HasOne(c => c.User)
25:                .WithMany(u => u.Comments)
26:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.UserId)
27:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
28: 
29:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Parent)
30:                .WithMany(c => c.Replies)
31:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ParentId)
32:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
33: 
34:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Moderator)
35:                .WithMany()
36:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ModeratedBy)
37:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
38: 
39:         // Thread loading index
40:         builder.HasIndex(c => new { c.ArticleId, c.CreatedAt })
41:                .HasFilter("[IsActive] = 1")
42:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Comments_Article_Thread");
43:     }
44: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Connection/ConnectionStringResolver.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: 
 4: public static class ConnectionStringResolver
 5: {
 6:     public static string Resolve(IConfiguration configuration)
 7:     {
 8:         var defaultConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
 9:         var altConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("AlternativeConnection");
10: 
11:         if (CanConnectToServer(defaultConn))
12:             return defaultConn!;
13: 
14:         if (CanConnectToServer(altConn))
15:             return altConn!;
16: 
17:         throw new InvalidOperationException(
18:             "Unable to connect to either DefaultConnection or AlternativeConnection.");
19:     }
20: 
21:     private static bool CanConnectToServer(string? connectionString)
22:     {
23:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
24:             return false;
25: 
26:         try
27:         {
28:             var builder = new SqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString)
29:             {
30:                 InitialCatalog = "master"
31:             };
32: 
33:             using var connection = new SqlConnection(builder.ConnectionString);
34:             connection.Open();
35:             return true;
36:         }
37:         catch
38:         {
39:             return false;
40:         }
41:     }
42: }

File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Seeding/DataSeeder.cs
================
  1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  6: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Configuration;
  7: 
  8: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seeding;
  9: 
 10: /// <summary>
 11: /// Applies migrations (creates DB if missing) and seeds reference data.
 12: /// Designed to be called once at application startup.
 13: /// </summary>
 14: public static class DataSeeder
 15: {
 16:     public static async Task SeedAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
 17:     {
 18:         using var scope = serviceProvider.CreateScope();
 19:         var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 20:         var logger = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<AppDbContext>>();
 21:         var configuration = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IConfiguration>();
 22: 
 23:         logger.LogInformation("Applying database migrations (will create DB if it does not exist)...");
 24:         await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
 25:         logger.LogInformation("Database migrations applied successfully.");
 26: 
 27:         await SeedRolesAsync(context, logger);
 28:         await SeedTopicsAsync(context, logger, configuration);
 29:         await SeedSourcesAsync(context, logger);
 30:         await SeedAdminUserAsync(context, logger);
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     private static async Task SeedRolesAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
 34:     {
 35:         if (await context.Roles.AnyAsync()) return;
 36: 
 37:         var roles = new List<Role>
 38:         {
 39:             new() { Name = "Admin" },
 40:             new() { Name = "Moderator" },
 41:             new() { Name = "User" }
 42:         };
 43: 
 44:         context.Roles.AddRange(roles);
 45:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 46:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} roles.", roles.Count);
 47:     }
 48: 
 49:     private static async Task SeedTopicsAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger, IConfiguration? configuration = null)
 50:     {
 51:         if (await context.Topics.AnyAsync()) return;
 52: 
 53:         List<Topic> topics;
 54: 
 55:         // ALWAYS try to load from configuration if provided
 56:         if (configuration != null)
 57:         {
 58:             var topicConfig = configuration.GetSection("Topics").Get<TopicConfiguration>();
 59:             if (topicConfig?.Topics != null && topicConfig.Topics.Any())
 60:             {
 61:                 topics = topicConfig.Topics.Select(t => t.ToEntity()).ToList();
 62:                 logger.LogInformation("Loading topics from configuration.");
 63:             }
 64:             else
 65:             {
 66:                 logger.LogWarning("No topics found in configuration, using defaults.");
 67:                 topics = GetDefaultTopics(logger);
 68:             }
 69:         }
 70:         else
 71:         {
 72:             logger.LogWarning("No configuration provided, using defaults.");
 73:             topics = GetDefaultTopics(logger);
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         context.Topics.AddRange(topics);
 77:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 78:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} topics.", topics.Count);
 79:     }
 80:

 97:         new() { Name = "Education", Slug = "education,learning,teaching", Description = "Learning, teaching, and academic breakthroughs" },

188: 
189:     private static async Task SeedAdminUserAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
190:     {
191:         if (await context.Users.AnyAsync()) return;
192: 
193:         // Seed a system/admin user to own future moderation actions.
194:         // In production, the password hash would come from a proper Identity hasher.
195:         var adminUser = new User
196:         {
197:             Email = "admin@positivenews.local",
198:             EmailConfirmed = true,
199:             Name = "System Administrator",
200:             PasswordHash = null, // Will be set via proper Auth flow later.
201:             IsActive = true
202:         };
203: 
204:         context.Users.Add(adminUser);
205:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
206: 
207:         var adminRole = await context.Roles.FirstAsync(r => r.Name == "Admin");
208:         context.UserRoles.Add(new UserRole { UserId = adminUser.Id, RoleId = adminRole.Id });
209:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
210: 
211:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded admin user '{Email}' with Admin role.", adminUser.Email);
212:     }
213: }
