================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  5: using System.Net;
  6: using System.Text;
  7: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
  8: 
  9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 10: 
 11: public class FeedItemCleaner : IFeedItemCleaner
 12: {
 13:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AllowedTags = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 14:     {
 15:         "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "p", "img", "video", "source", "ul", "ol", "li", "a", "iframe"
 16:     };
 17: 
 18:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AttributesToRemove = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 19:     {
 20:         "class", "style", "block_context"
 21:     };
 22: 
 23:     private static readonly string[] RemoveDivClassPatterns =
 24:     {
 25:         "navigation-menu",
 26:         "hds-featured-link-list",
 27:         "blocks-content-lists",
 28:         "nasa-blocks-article-intro",
 29:         "nasa-blocks-article-hero-header",
 30:         "hds-featured-file-list",
 31:         "listicle-layout-basic",
 32:         "hds-audio-player-",
 33:         "secondary-navigation",
 34:         "comparison-slider-parent",
 35:         "two-up-view",
 36:         "content-lists-inner",
 37:         "topic-cards",
 38:         "twitter-tweet",
 39:         "attachment-medium size-medium wp-post-image" //first image for Design You Trust
 40:     };
 41: 
 42:     // Patterns that trigger "stop processing all following content"
 43:     private static readonly string[] StopProcessingPatterns =
 44:     {
 45:         "About the Author",
 46:         //"For more information about",
 47:         "Discover More Topics From",
 48:         //"For more information on",
 49:         "Click here to leave a comment on the site",
 50:         "Members can also look for the following:",
 51:         "What are you planning to play this weekend?",
 52:         "in the comments below.",
 53:         "-end-",
 54:         "-fin-"
 55:     };
 56: 
 57:     // Patterns that trigger removal of a single node
 58:     private static readonly string[] RemoveNodePatterns =
 59:     {
 60:     "Learn more about this image",
 61:     "Listen to this audio",
 62:     "Follow NVIDIA Workstation on",
 63:     "Plug in to NVIDIA AI PC on",
 64:     "follow us on",
 65:     "Donate link:",
 66:     "The Optimist Daily is a project of the World Business Academy",
 67:     "Subscribe to our",
 68:     "Want to be part of the Optimism Movement?",
 69:     "If you have questions, comments, feedback, suggestions, or just want to say hi, send a message to:"
 70:     };
 71: 
 72:     private static readonly Regex YoutubeRegex = new(
 73:     @"(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?(?:youtube\.com/watch\?v=|youtu\.be/|youtube\.com/embed/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})",
 74:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 75: 
 76:     private static readonly Regex StrongTildeRegex = new(
 77:     @"<strong>\s*(?<left>[^~<]+?)\s*~\s*[^<]*\s*</strong>",
 78:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 79: 
 80:     private static readonly Regex AppearedFirstOnRegex = new(
 81:     @"<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*appeared first on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 82:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 83: 
 84:     private static readonly Regex OptimistEditorialRegex = new(
 85:     @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY(?:’S|'S)? EDITORIAL TEAM",
 86:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 87: 
 88:     private static readonly Regex ThePostRegex = new(
 89:     @"The post\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*first appeared on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 90:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline);
 91: 
 92:     private static readonly Regex HtmlTagRegex = new(
 93:     @"<[^>]+>",
 94:     RegexOptions.Compiled);
 95: 
 96:     private static readonly Regex RemoveTrailingPostLinksRegex = new(
 97:     @"<\/p>\s*The post\s*<a.*?<\/a>.*",
 98:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 99: 
100:     private static readonly Regex AppearedFirstOnTextRegex = new(
101:     @"appeared first on",
102:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
103: 
104:     private static readonly Regex OptimistDailyTextRegex = new(
105:     @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY",
106:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
107: 
108:     private static readonly Regex StartsWithThePostRegex = new(
109:     @"^The post ",
110:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
111: 
112:     private static readonly Regex ThePostSentenceRegex = new(
113:     @"The post .*? first appeared on .*?\.",
114:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline | RegexOptions.Compiled);
115: 
116:     private static readonly Regex OptimistDailySentenceRegex = new(
117:     @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY.*?(?=\.)",
118:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
119: 
120:     public RssFeedItemDto Clean(RssFeedItemDto dto, TopicLookup lookup, HtmlNode? rawContentNode)
121:     {
122:         dto.Description = CleanDescription(dto.Description);
123:         dto.ContentRaw = CleanContent(dto.ContentRaw, rawContentNode);
124:         dto.Title = CleanTitle(dto.Title);
125:         dto.Topics = CleanTopics(dto.Topics, lookup);
126:         return dto;
127:     }
128: 
129:     public string? StripInnerHtmlWords(string? htmlContent, HtmlNode? htmlNode = null)
130:     {
131:         if (htmlNode != null)
132:             return htmlNode.InnerText;
133: 
134:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(htmlContent))
135:             return htmlContent;
136: 
137:         return LoadDocument(htmlContent).DocumentNode.InnerText;
138:     }
139: 
140:     private static HtmlDocument LoadDocument(string html)
141:     {
142:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
143:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
144:         return doc;
145:     }
146: 
147:     private static string CleanContent(string rawContent, HtmlNode? rawContentNode)
148:     {
149:         var rootNode = rawContentNode ?? LoadDocument(rawContent).DocumentNode;
150:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
151:         var stopProcessing = false;
152: 
153:         ProcessNodesIterative(rootNode, builder, ref stopProcessing);
154: 
155:         var cleaned = RemoveTrailingPostLinks(builder.ToString());
156:         return RemoveTildeAuthor(cleaned).Trim();  
157:     }
158: 
159:     private static void ProcessNodesIterative(HtmlNode root, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
160:     {
161:         var stack = new Stack<HtmlNode>();
162:         PushChildrenInReverse(root, stack);
163: 
164:         while (stack.Count > 0)
165:         {
166:             if (stopProcessing)
167:                 return;
168: 
169:             var node = stack.Pop();
170:             if (node.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
171:                 continue;
172: 
173:             if (ShouldStopProcessing(node))
174:             {
175:                 stopProcessing = true;
176:                 return;
177:             }
178: 
179:             if (ShouldRemoveNode(node))
180:                 continue;
181: 
182:             var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
183: 
184:             if (tagName == "div")
185:             {
186:                 ProcessDiv(node, builder, stack);
187:                 continue;
188:             }
189: 
190:             if (tagName == "a")
191:             {
192:                 ProcessAnchor(node, builder, stack);
193:                 continue;
194:             }
195: 
196:             if ((tagName == "ul" || tagName == "ol") && HasClassContaining(node, "wp-block-list"))
197:             {
198:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
199:                 continue;
200:             }
201: 
202:             if (AllowedTags.Contains(tagName))
203:             {
204:                 ProcessAllowedNode(node, tagName, builder);
205:                 continue;
206:             }
207: 
208:             PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
209:         }
210:     }
211: 
212:     private static void ProcessDiv(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
213:     {
214:         // Check if div should be removed by class
215:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
216:         {
217:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
218:                 return;
219:         }
220: 
221:         // Transform hds-caption-text divs to small italic paragraph
222:         if (HasClassContaining(node, "hds-caption-text"))
223:         {
224:             var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
225:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
226:             {
227:                 builder.AppendLine($"<p class=\"small fst-italic\">{System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(text)}</p>");
228:             }
229:             return;
230:         }
231: 
232:         // Otherwise, process children of the div
233:         PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
234:     }
235: 
236:     private static void ProcessAnchor(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
237:     {
238:         var href = node.GetAttributeValue("href", "");
239: 
240:         // Check if it's a YouTube link
241:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(href);
242:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
243:         {
244:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
245:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
246:             return;
247:         }
248: 
249:         // Check for YouTube links in the anchor's inner content (nested links)
250:         var innerHtml = node.InnerHtml;
251:         var innerMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(innerHtml);
252:         if (innerMatch.Success)
253:         {
254:             var videoId = innerMatch.Groups[1].Value;
255:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
256:             return;
257:         }
258: 
259:         // Otherwise, process anchor normally (keep it, process children)
260:         PushChildrenInReverse(node, stack);
261:     }
262: 
263:     private static string CreateYouTubeEmbed(string videoId)
264:     {
265:         return $@"<div class=""ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3"">
266:                 <iframe src=""https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId}"" 
267:                 title=""YouTube video"" 
268:                 allow=""accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"" 
269:                 allowfullscreen>
270:                 </iframe>
271:                 </div>";
272:     }
273: 
274:     private static void ProcessList(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
275:     {
276:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
277:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
278:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
279:     }
280: 
281:     private static void ProcessAllowedNode(HtmlNode node, string tagName, StringBuilder builder)
282:     {
283:         switch (tagName)
284:         {
285:             case "p":
286:                 ProcessParagraph(node, builder);
287:                 break;
288: 
289:             case "h1":
290:             case "h2":
291:             case "h3":
292:             case "h4":
293:                 ProcessHeader(node, builder);
294:                 break;
295: 
296:             case "img":
297:                 ProcessImage(node, builder);
298:                 break;
299: 
300:             case "video":
301:                 ProcessVideo(node, builder);
302:                 break;
303: 
304:             case "ul":
305:             case "ol":
306:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
307:                 break;
308: 
309:             case "li":
310:                 ProcessListItem(node, builder);
311:                 break;
312: 
313:             case "iframe":
314:                 ProcessIframe(node, builder);
315:                 break;
316:         }
317:     }
318: 
319:     private static void ProcessParagraph(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
320:     {
321:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
322: 
323:         // Check for YouTube iframes FIRST and extract them
324:         var iframes = node.SelectNodes(".//iframe");
325:         if (iframes != null)
326:         {
327:             foreach (var iframe in iframes)
328:             {
329:                 var src = iframe.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
330:                 var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
331:                 if (youtubeMatch.Success)
332:                 {
333:                     var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
334:                     builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
335:                 }
336:             }
337:         }
338: 
339:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
340: 
341:         // Include iframe in media check
342:         var hasMedia = node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video | .//iframe") != null;
343:         var hasText = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text);
344: 
345:         // If paragraph ONLY contained iframe (already processed above), skip outputting empty <p>
346:         if (!hasText && iframes != null && node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video") == null)
347:             return;
348: 
349:         if (!hasText && !hasMedia)
350:             return;
351: 
352:         if (hasText && ShouldRemoveParagraph(text))
353:             return;
354: 
355:         var images = node.SelectNodes(".//img");
356:         if (images != null)
357:         {
358:             foreach (var img in images.ToList())
359:             {
360:                 var imgBuilder = new StringBuilder();
361:                 ProcessImage(img, imgBuilder);
362:             }
363:         }
364: 
365:         // THEN clean paragraph in-place (without overriding media-specific classes)
366:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(
367:             node,
368:             skipTags: new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase) { "img", "video", "iframe" });
369:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
370:     }
371: 
372:     private static void ProcessHeader(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
373:     {
374:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
375: 
376:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
377:             return;
378: 
379:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
380:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
381:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
382:     }
383: 
384:     private static void ProcessImage(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
385:     {
386:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
387: 
388:         if (classAttr.Contains("attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||
389:             classAttr.Contains("wp-biographia-avatar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
390:             classAttr.Contains("wp-smiley", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||  // ← Add this for emoji
391:             classAttr.Contains("emoji", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
392:         {
393:             SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
394:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3");
395:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
396:         }
397:         else
398:         {
399:             SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
400:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3");
401:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
402:         }
403:     }
404: 
405:     private static void ProcessVideo(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
406:     {
407:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
408:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
409:         node.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100 rounded mb-3");
410:         node.SetAttributeValue("controls", "");
411: 
412:         var sources = node.SelectNodes(".//source");
413:         if (sources != null)
414:         {
415:             foreach (var source in sources)
416:                 SanitizeElementAttributes(source, preserveClass: false);
417:         }
418: 
419:         var videoHtml = node.OuterHtml;
420:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{videoHtml}</div>");
421:     }
422: 
423:     private static void ProcessIframe(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
424:     {
425:         var src = node.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
426: 
427:         // Check if it's a YouTube embed
428:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
429:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
430:         {
431:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
432:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
433:             return;
434:         }
435: 
436:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
437:         SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
438:         node.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100");
439:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{node.OuterHtml}</div>");
440:     }
441: 
442:     private static void ProcessListItem(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
443:     {
444:         RemoveUnsafeDescendants(node);
445:         SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(node);
446:         builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
447:     }
448: 
449:     private static void PushChildrenInReverse(HtmlNode node, Stack<HtmlNode> stack)
450:     {
451:         for (var i = node.ChildNodes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
452:         {
453:             stack.Push(node.ChildNodes[i]);
454:         }
455:     }
456: 
457:     private static void RemoveUnsafeDescendants(HtmlNode node)
458:     {
459:         var disallowedTags = node.SelectNodes(".//script | .//style | .//noscript");
460:         if (disallowedTags == null)
461:             return;
462: 
463:         foreach (var tag in disallowedTags.ToList())
464:             tag.Remove();
465:     }
466: 
467:     private static void SanitizeAttributesInSubtree(HtmlNode root, IReadOnlySet<string>? skipTags = null)
468:     {
469:         var stack = new Stack<HtmlNode>();
470:         stack.Push(root);
471: 
472:         while (stack.Count > 0)
473:         {
474:             var node = stack.Pop();
475: 
476:             if (node.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
477:             {
478:                 var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
479:                 if (skipTags == null || !skipTags.Contains(tagName))
480:                 {
481:                     SanitizeElementAttributes(node, preserveClass: false);
482:                 }
483:             }
484: 
485:             for (var i = node.ChildNodes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
486:             {
487:                 stack.Push(node.ChildNodes[i]);
488:             }
489:         }
490:     }
491: 
492:     private static void SanitizeElementAttributes(HtmlNode node, bool preserveClass)
493:     {
494:         if (node.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
495:             return;
496: 
497:         var toRemove = node.Attributes
498:             .Where(attr =>
499:                 (!preserveClass && AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name)) ||
500:                 attr.Name.StartsWith("on", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
501:             .Select(attr => attr.Name)
502:             .ToList();
503: 
504:         foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
505:         {
506:             node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
507:         }
508:     }
509: 
510:     private static bool HasClassContaining(HtmlNode node, string pattern)
511:     {
512:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
513:         return classAttr.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
514:     }
515: 
516:     private static bool HasExactClass(HtmlNode node, string exactClass)
517:     {
518:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
519:         return classAttr.Equals(exactClass, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
520:     }
521: 
522:     private static bool ShouldStopProcessing(HtmlNode node)
523:     {
524:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
525: 
526:         // Check for single "Share" text
527:         if (text.Equals("Share", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
528:             return true;
529: 
530:         // Check for stop-processing patterns
531:         foreach (var pattern in StopProcessingPatterns)
532:         {
533:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
534:                 return true;
535:         }
536: 
537:         return false;
538:     }
539: 
540:     private static bool ShouldRemoveNode(HtmlNode node)
541:     {
542:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText);
543: 
544:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveNodePatterns)
545:         {
546:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
547:                 return true;
548:         }
549: 
550:         var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
551: 
552:        
553:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
554:         {
555:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
556:                 return true;
557:         }
558:         
559: 
560:         // Check for thumbnail images
561:         if (tagName == "img" && HasExactClass(node, "attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail"))
562:             return true;
563: 
564:         // ADD: Always remove script tags
565:         if (tagName == "script")
566:             return true;
567: 
568:         return false;
569:     }
570: 
571:     private static bool ShouldRemoveParagraph(string text)
572:     {
573:         var lower = text.ToLowerInvariant();
574:         return lower.Contains("did this solution stand out")
575:             || lower.Contains("becoming an emissary")
576:             || lower.StartsWith("the post ")
577:             || lower.Contains("appeared first on");
578:     }
579: 
580:     private static string RemoveTrailingPostLinks(string content)
581:     {
582:         return RemoveTrailingPostLinksRegex.Replace(content, "");
583:     }
584: 
585:     private static string CleanDescription(string description)
586:     {
587:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
588:             return string.Empty;
589: 
590:         // Decode HTML entities first
591:         var html = WebUtility.HtmlDecode(description);
592: 
593:         html = ThePostRegex.Replace(html, "");
594: 
595:         // -------------------------------------------------------
596:         // 1. Remove "~something" inside <strong>
597:         // -------------------------------------------------------
598:         html = StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
599: 
600:         // -------------------------------------------------------
601:         // 2. Remove unwanted editorial paragraph
602:         // -------------------------------------------------------
603:         html = OptimistEditorialRegex.Replace(html, "");
604: 
605:         // -------------------------------------------------------
606:         // 3. Remove "appeared first on Colossal"
607:         // -------------------------------------------------------
608:         html = AppearedFirstOnRegex.Replace(html, "");
609: 
610:         if (!ContainsHtmlMarkup(html))
611:             return TrimAfterLastDot(html);
612: 
613:         // -------------------------------------------------------
614:         // 4. Parse HTML safely
615:         // -------------------------------------------------------
616:         var doc = LoadDocument(html);
617: 
618:         var paragraphs = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes(".//p");
619: 
620:         if (paragraphs == null || paragraphs.Count == 0)
621:             return TrimAfterLastDot(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText);
622: 
623:         var texts = paragraphs
624:     .Select(p => HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(p.InnerText).Trim())
625:     .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
626:     .Where(t =>
627:         !AppearedFirstOnTextRegex.IsMatch(t) &&
628:         !OptimistDailyTextRegex.IsMatch(t) &&
629:         !StartsWithThePostRegex.IsMatch(t)
630:     );
631: 
632:         var result = string.Join(" ", texts);
633: 
634:         // Final safety cleanup (text-level)
635:         result = ThePostSentenceRegex.Replace(result, "");
636: 
637:         result = OptimistDailySentenceRegex.Replace(result, "");
638: 
639:         result = result.Length > 1999 ? result[..1999] : result;
640: 
641:         // -------------------------------------------------------
642:         // 5. Trim everything after last dot
643:         // -------------------------------------------------------
644:         return TrimAfterLastDot(result);
645:     }
646: 
647:     private static string TrimAfterLastDot(string text)
648:     {
649:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
650:             return text;
651: 
652:         var lastDotIndex = text.LastIndexOf('.');
653: 
654:         if (lastDotIndex > 0)
655:             return text.Substring(0, lastDotIndex + 1).Trim();
656: 
657:         return text.Trim();
658:     }
659: 
660:     private static string CleanTitle(string title)
661:     {
662:         return title.Length > 500 ? title[..500] : title;
663:     }
664: 
665:     private static string RemoveTildeAuthor(string html)
666:     {
667:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
668:             return html;
669: 
670:         return StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
671:     }
672: 
673:     private static bool ContainsHtmlMarkup(string input)
674:     {
675:         return HtmlTagRegex.IsMatch(input);
676:     }
677: 
678:     public List<string> CleanTopics(List<string> topics, TopicLookup lookup)
679:     {
680:         if (topics == null || topics.Count == 0)
681:             return [];
682: 
683:         var result = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
684: 
685:         foreach (var raw in topics)
686:         {
687:             // Only split and match individual words, don't add the original raw string
688:             var words = raw
689:                 .Split(new[] { ' ', ',', ';', '&', '/', '|', '-' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
690:                 .Select(w => w.Trim().ToLowerInvariant())
691:                 .Where(w => w.Length > 2); // Ignore short words like "new", "the", "and"
692: 
693:             foreach (var word in words)
694:             {
695:                 if (lookup.BySlugWord.TryGetValue(word, out var matchedTopics))
696:                 {
697:                     foreach (var topic in matchedTopics)
698:                     {
699:                         // Only add if the word meaningfully matches
700:                         if (IsMeaningfulMatch(word, topic))
701:                         {
702:                             result.Add(topic.Name);
703:                         }
704:                     }
705:                 }
706:             }
707:         }
708: 
709:         return result.ToList();
710:     }
711: 
712:     private bool IsMeaningfulMatch(string word, Topic topic)
713:     {
714:         // Don't match common short words
715:         var commonWords = new[] { "new", "old", "big", "small", "good", "bad", "hot", "cold" };
716:         if (commonWords.Contains(word))
717:             return false;
718: 
719:         // Don't match if the word is just a number
720:         if (int.TryParse(word, out _))
721:             return false;
722: 
723:         return true;
724:     }
725: }

  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: 
  6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
  7: 
  8: public class FeedItemEnricher : IFeedItemEnricher
  9: {
 10:     private readonly ILogger<FeedItemEnricher> _logger;
 11: 
 12:     public FeedItemEnricher(ILogger<FeedItemEnricher> logger)
 13:     {
 14:         _logger = logger;
 15:     }
 16: 
 17:     public RssFeedItemDto EnrichTopics(string feedUrl, RssFeedItemDto dto, TopicLookup lookup)
 18:     {
 19:         var result = new HashSet<string>(dto.Topics, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 20: 
 21:         void Add(string name)
 22:         {
 23:             if (lookup.ByName.ContainsKey(name))
 24:                 result.Add(name);
 25:         }
 26: 
 27:         if (feedUrl.Contains("nvidia", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 28:             Add("Technology");
 29: 
 30:         if (feedUrl.Contains("nasa", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 31:         {
 32:             Add("Space");
 33:             Add("Technology");
 34:             Add("Science");
 35:         }
 36: 
 37:         if (feedUrl.Contains("thisiscolossal", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
 38:             feedUrl.Contains("designyoutrust", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 39:         {
 40:             Add("Arts & Culture");
 41:         }
 42: 
 43:         if (feedUrl.Contains("tinybuddha", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
 44:             Add("Psychology");
 45: 
 46:         var expandedTopics = new HashSet<string>(result, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
 47:         foreach (var topicName in result.ToList())
 48:         {
 49:             if (!lookup.ByName.TryGetValue(topicName, out var topic))
 50:                 continue;
 51: 
 52:             var slugWords = topic.Slug
 53:                 .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
 54:                 .Select(w => w.Trim());
 55: 
 56:             foreach (var word in slugWords)
 57:             {
 58:                 if (lookup.ByName.TryGetValue(word, out var related))
 59:                     result.Add(related.Name);
 60:             }
 61:         }
 62: 
 63:         foreach (var expanded in expandedTopics)
 64:             result.Add(expanded);
 65: 
 66:         if (result.Count == 0)
 67:             Add("Default");
 68: 
 69:         dto.Topics = result.ToList();
 70:         return dto;
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     public string AddHeroImage(string contentRaw, string? imageTag, HtmlNode? contentNode)
 74:     {
 75:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentRaw) ||
 76:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(imageTag) ||
 77:             ContainsHeroImage(contentNode))
 78:         {
 79:             return contentRaw;
 80:         }
 81: 
 82:         return string.Concat(imageTag, contentRaw);
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     private bool ContainsHeroImage(HtmlNode? htmlNode)
 86:     {
 87:         try
 88:         {
 89:             if (htmlNode == null)
 90:                 return false;
 91: 
 92:             var images = htmlNode.SelectNodes(".//img");
 93:             if (images == null || images.Count == 0)
 94:                 return false;
 95: 
 96:             return images.Any(img =>
 97:             {
 98:                 var classAttr = img.GetAttributeValue("class", string.Empty);
 99:                 return classAttr.Contains("img-fluid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
100:                        classAttr.Contains("w-100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
101:             });
102:         }
103:         catch (Exception ex)
104:         {
105:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error checking for hero image in HTML content");
106:             return false;
107:         }
108:     }
109: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemParser.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 4: using System.Xml.Linq;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 7: 
 8: public class FeedItemParser : IFeedItemParser
 9: {
10:     private readonly ILogger<FeedItemParser> _logger;
11:     
12:     private static readonly XNamespace DcNs = "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/";
13:     private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";
14: 
15:     public FeedItemParser(ILogger<FeedItemParser> logger)
16:     {
17:         _logger = logger;
18:     }
19: 
20:     public RssFeedItemDto Parse(XElement itemElement)
21:     {
22:         return new RssFeedItemDto
23:         {
24:             Title = itemElement.Element("title")?.Value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
25:             Link = itemElement.Element("link")?.Value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
26:             Description = itemElement.Element("description")?.Value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
27:             ContentRaw = itemElement.Element(ContentNs + "encoded")?.Value?.Trim() ?? string.Empty,
28:             Author = itemElement.Element(DcNs + "creator")?.Value?.Trim(),
29:             PublishedDate = ParseDate(itemElement),
30:             Topics = ExtractCategories(itemElement),
31:             ExternalId = itemElement.Element("guid")?.Value?.Trim()
32:         };
33:     }
34:     private List<string> ExtractCategories(XElement itemElement)
35:     {
36:         var categories = itemElement
37:             .Elements("category")
38:             .Select(c => c.Value)
39:             .Where(v => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v))
40:             .Distinct()
41:             .ToList(); // Creates a NEW list each time
42: 
43:         if (categories.Count == 0)
44:         {
45:             categories = ["Default"];
46:         }
47: 
48:         _logger.LogDebug("Extracted categories: {Categories}", string.Join(", ", categories));
49:         return categories;
50:     }
51: 
52:     private static DateTime ParseDate(XElement item)
53:     {
54:         var dateStr = item.Element("pubDate")?.Value?.Trim();
55: 
56:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dateStr))
57:         {
58:             // Common RSS date formats
59:             string[] formats = new[]
60:             {
61:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz",
62:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss K",
63:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss",
64:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz",
65:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssK",
66:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss"
67:             };
68: 
69:             if (DateTime.TryParseExact(dateStr, formats,
70:                 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
71:                 System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
72:             {
73:                 return result;
74:             }
75:             // Try standard parse as fallback
76:             if (DateTime.TryParse(dateStr, out result))
77:             {
78:                 return result;
79:             }
80:         }
81:         return DateTime.UtcNow;
82:     }
83: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemValidator.cs
================
 1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 4: using System.Net;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 7: 
 8: public class FeedItemValidator : IFeedItemValidator
 9: {
10:     public bool IsValid(RssFeedItemDto item, HtmlNode? contentNode) //TODO: Additional validation
11:     {
12:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Title) ||
13:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Link) ||
14:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Description) ||
15:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.ContentRaw))
16:             return false;
17: 
18:         if (item.Author == "tinybuddha")
19:             return false;
20: 
21:         if (contentNode == null ||
22:             contentNode.InnerHtml == null ||
23:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(contentNode.InnerText) ||
24:             contentNode.InnerText.Length < 25)
25:         {
26:             return false;
27:         }
28: 
29:         return true;
30:     }
31: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedProcessor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using System.Xml.Linq;
  6: 
  7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
  8: 
  9: public class FeedProcessor : IFeedProcessor
 10: {
 11:     private readonly ILogger<FeedProcessor> _logger;
 12:     private readonly IFeedItemValidator _validator;
 13:     private readonly IFeedItemParser _parser;
 14:     private readonly IFeedItemCleaner _cleaner;
 15:     private readonly IFeedItemEnricher _enricher;
 16:     private readonly IImgTagExtractor _imgTagExtractor;
 17:     private readonly IPositivityAnalyzer _analyzer;
 18: 
 19:     public FeedProcessor(
 20:        IFeedItemValidator validator,
 21:        IFeedItemParser parser,
 22:        IFeedItemCleaner cleaner,
 23:        IFeedItemEnricher enricher,
 24:        ILogger<FeedProcessor> logger,
 25:        IImgTagExtractor imgTagExtractor,
 26:        IPositivityAnalyzer analyzer)
 27:     {
 28:         _validator = validator;
 29:         _parser = parser;
 30:         _cleaner = cleaner;
 31:         _enricher = enricher;
 32:         _imgTagExtractor = imgTagExtractor;
 33:         _logger = logger;
 34:         _analyzer = analyzer;
 35:     }
 36: 
 37:     public FeedProcessingResult ProcessFeed(string feedUrl, XDocument feed, TopicLookup lookup, 
 38:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 39:     {
 40:         var dtoItems = new List<RssFeedItemDto>();
 41:         var invalidCount = 0;
 42: 
 43:         _logger.LogInformation("Processing RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
 44: 
 45:         foreach (var feedItem in feed.Descendants("item"))
 46:         {
 47:             cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
 48: 
 49:             try
 50:             {
 51:                 if (!TryProcessFeedItem(feedUrl, feedItem, lookup, out var dtoItem))
 52:                 {
 53:                     invalidCount++;
 54:                     continue;
 55:                 }
 56: 
 57:                 dtoItems.Add(dtoItem);
 58:             }
 59:             catch (Exception ex)
 60:             {
 61:                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error parsing RSS feed item");
 62:                 invalidCount++;
 63:             }
 64: 
 65:             _logger.LogDebug("Feed item No.{Count} has been successfully processed.", dtoItems.Count);
 66:         }
 67: 
 68:         return new FeedProcessingResult(dtoItems, invalidCount);
 69:     }
 70:     private bool TryProcessFeedItem(string feedUrl, XElement feedItem, TopicLookup lookup, out RssFeedItemDto dtoItem)
 71:     {
 72:         dtoItem = _parser.Parse(feedItem);
 73: 
 74:         var rawContentNode = ParseHtmlNode(dtoItem.ContentRaw);
 75:         if (!_validator.IsValid(dtoItem, rawContentNode))
 76:         {
 77:             _logger.LogWarning("Skipping invalid feed item.");
 78:             return false;
 79:         }
 80: 
 81:         dtoItem = _cleaner.Clean(dtoItem, lookup, rawContentNode);
 82: 
 83:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dtoItem.ContentRaw))
 84:             return false;
 85: 
 86:         dtoItem = _enricher.EnrichTopics(feedUrl, dtoItem, lookup);
 87: 
 88:         var cleanedContentNode = ParseHtmlNode(dtoItem.ContentRaw);
 89:         var descriptionNode = ParseHtmlNode(dtoItem.Description);
 90: 
 91:         dtoItem.ContentClean = _cleaner.StripInnerHtmlWords(dtoItem.ContentRaw, cleanedContentNode)
 92:             ?? _cleaner.StripInnerHtmlWords(dtoItem.Description, descriptionNode);
 93:         dtoItem.PositivityScore = _analyzer.AnalyzeSentiment(dtoItem.ContentClean);
 94: 
 95:         dtoItem.ImageTag = _imgTagExtractor.ExtractImgTag(feedItem, feedUrl, cleanedContentNode, descriptionNode);
 96:         dtoItem.ContentRaw = _enricher.AddHeroImage(dtoItem.ContentRaw, dtoItem.ImageTag, cleanedContentNode);
 97: 
 98:         return true;
 99:     }
100: 
101:     private static HtmlNode? ParseHtmlNode(string? html)
102:     {
103:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
104:             return null;
105: 
106:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
107:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
108:         return doc.DocumentNode;
109:     }
110: }

 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

 4: using System.Xml.Linq;

 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;

 8: public class FeedReader : IFeedReader
 9: {

11:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
12: 
13:     public FeedReader(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<FeedReader> logger)
14:     {
15:         _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
16:         _logger = logger;
17:     }
18: 
19:     async Task<XDocument> IFeedReader.ReadFeedAsync(string feedUrl, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
20:     {
21:         _logger.LogInformation("Fetching RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
22: 
23:         var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("RssFeedClient");
24:         using var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(feedUrl, cancellationToken);
25:         response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
26: 
27:         using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken);
28:         return await XDocument.LoadAsync(stream, LoadOptions.None, cancellationToken);
29:     }
30: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer.cs
================
 1: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 2: 
 3: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 4: 
 5: public class KeyPhrasePositivityAnalyzer : IPositivityAnalyzer
 6: {
 7:     private static readonly HashSet<string> PositiveWords = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 8:     {
 9:         "good", "great", "excellent", "positive", "happy", "success", "breakthrough",
10:         "innovative", "uplifting", "joy", "wonderful", "win", "progress", "inspiring",
11:         "cure", "hero", "solution", "miracle", "triumph", "beautiful", "love"
12:     };
13: 
14:     private static readonly HashSet<string> NegativeWords = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
15:     {
16:         "bad", "terrible", "awful", "negative", "sad", "fail", "failure", "crisis",
17:         "disaster", "tragedy", "loss", "pain", "death", "murder", "war", "crash",
18:         "devastating", "horrible", "fear", "hate", "violence"
19:     };
20: 
21:     public decimal AnalyzeSentiment(string? plainTextContent)
22:     {
23:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(plainTextContent))
24:             return 0.5000m; // Neutral default
25: 
26:         // 1. Split text into distinct words
27:         var words = plainTextContent.Split(new[] { ' ', '.', ',', ';', '!', '?', '\n', '\r', '"', '\'' },
28:                                StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
29: 
30:         int posCount = 0;
31:         int negCount = 0;
32: 
33:         foreach (var word in words)
34:         {
35:             if (PositiveWords.Contains(word)) posCount++;
36:             if (NegativeWords.Contains(word)) negCount++;
37:         }
38: 
39:         int totalScored = posCount + negCount;
40: 
41:         if (totalScored == 0)
42:             return 0.5000m; // Neutral if no keywords matched
43: 
44:         // 2. Calculate score between 0.0000 and 1.0000
45:         decimal score = (decimal)posCount / totalScored;
46: 
47:         return Math.Round(score, 3);
48:     }
49: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/PreviewImgTagExtractor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  6: using System;
  7: using System.Collections.Generic;
  8: using System.Net;
  9: using System.Text;
 10: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
 11: using System.Xml.Linq;
 12: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Constants;
 13: 
 14: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 15: 
 16: public class PreviewImgTagExtractor : IImgTagExtractor
 17: {
 18:     private readonly ILogger<PreviewImgTagExtractor> _logger;
 19: 
 20:     private static readonly XNamespace MediaNs = "http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/";
 21:     private static readonly Regex SrcsetCandidateRegex = new(
 22:         @"(?<url>\S+)(?:\s+(?<w>\d+)w)?",
 23:         RegexOptions.Compiled);
 24: 
 25:     public PreviewImgTagExtractor(ILogger<PreviewImgTagExtractor> logger)
 26:     {
 27:         _logger = logger;
 28:     }
 29:     public string? ExtractImgTag(XElement itemElement, string feedUrl, HtmlNode? contentNode, HtmlNode? descriptionNode)
 30:     {
 31:         try
 32:         {
 33:             // 1. media:thumbnail (direct child or nested inside media:content)
 34:             var thumbnail =
 35:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail") ??
 36:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content")?.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail");
 37: 
 38:             if (thumbnail != null)
 39:             {
 40:                 return BuildImgTag(
 41:                     src: thumbnail.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 42:                     width: thumbnail.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 43:                     height: thumbnail.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 44:                     alt: thumbnail.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article thumbnail"
 45:                 );
 46:             }
 47: 
 48:             // 2. Preferred <img> inside <description>
 49:             var imgFromDesc = ExtractPreferredImgFromNode(descriptionNode);
 50:             if (imgFromDesc != null)
 51:                 return imgFromDesc;
 52: 
 53:             // 3. Preferred <img> inside content
 54:             var imgFromEncoded = ExtractPreferredImgFromNode(contentNode);
 55:             if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 56:                 return imgFromEncoded;
 57: 
 58:             // 4. media:content (only reached if needed)
 59:             var mediaContent = itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content");
 60:             if (mediaContent != null)
 61:             {
 62:                 return BuildImgTag(
 63:                     src: mediaContent.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 64:                     width: mediaContent.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 65:                     height: mediaContent.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 66:                     alt: mediaContent.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article image"
 67:                 );
 68:             }
 69: 
 70:             // 5. Any <img> inside <description>
 71:             imgFromDesc = ExtractAnyImgFromNode(descriptionNode);
 72:             if (imgFromDesc != null)
 73:                 return imgFromDesc;
 74: 
 75:             // 6. Any <img> inside content
 76:             imgFromEncoded = ExtractAnyImgFromNode(contentNode);
 77:             if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 78:                 return imgFromEncoded;
 79: 
 80:             _logger.LogDebug("No thumbnail image tag extracted for current article. Default will be assigned");
 81:             return AssignDefaultThumbnailImg(feedUrl);
 82:         }
 83:         catch (Exception ex)
 84:         {
 85:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error during image tag extraction");
 86:             return null;
 87:         }
 88:     }
 89: 
 90: 
 91:     private static string? ExtractImgFromNode(HtmlNode? rootNode, string xpathQuery)
 92:     {
 93:         if (rootNode == null)
 94:             return null;
 95:         
 96:         var images = rootNode.SelectNodes(xpathQuery);
 97: 
 98:         var img = images
 99:             ?.OrderBy(node =>
100:             {
101:                 var heightAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("height", "");
102:                 var widthAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("width", "");
103: 
104:                 var height = int.TryParse(heightAttr, out var h) ? h : int.MaxValue;
105:                 var width = int.TryParse(widthAttr, out var w) ? w : int.MaxValue;
106: 
107:                 return height == int.MaxValue || width == int.MaxValue ? int.MaxValue : height / (double)width;
108:             })
109:             .FirstOrDefault();
110: 
111:         if (img == null)
112:             return null;
113: 
114:         return BuildImgTag(
115:             src: img.GetAttributeValue("src", ""),
116:             width: img.GetAttributeValue("width", ""),
117:             height: img.GetAttributeValue("height", ""),
118:             alt: img.GetAttributeValue("alt", "Article image"),
119:             srcset: img.GetAttributeValue("srcset", ""),
120:             sizes: img.GetAttributeValue("sizes", "")
121:         );
122:     }
123: 
124:     private static string? ExtractPreferredImgFromNode(HtmlNode? rootNode)
125:     => ExtractImgFromNode(rootNode, ".//img[@srcset and not(@class=\"img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3\")]");
126: 
127:     private static string? ExtractAnyImgFromNode(HtmlNode? rootNode)
128:         => ExtractImgFromNode(rootNode, ".//img");
129: 
130:     private static string? CleanSrcsetForPreview(string? srcset)
131:     {
132:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
133:             return null;
134: 
135:         // Matches: URL + optional descriptor (e.g. "300w")
136:         var matches = SrcsetCandidateRegex.Matches(srcset);
137: 
138:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int? width)>();
139: 
140:         foreach (Match match in matches)
141:         {
142:             var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
143:             int? width = null;
144: 
145:             if (match.Groups["w"].Success &&
146:                 int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
147:             {
148:                 width = w;
149:             }
150: 
151:             // Skip garbage matches
152:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url) || !url.StartsWith("http"))
153:                 continue;
154: 
155:             candidates.Add((url, width));
156:         }
157: 
158:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
159:             return null;
160: 
161:         var maxWidth = GetPreferredMaxWidth(candidates);
162: 
163:         var filtered = candidates
164:             .Where(c => !c.width.HasValue || c.width <= maxWidth)
165:             .OrderBy(c => c.width ?? int.MaxValue)
166:             .ToList();
167: 
168:         // Fallback: if nothing <= 1024, take smallest available
169:         if (filtered.Count == 0)
170:         {
171:             var smallest = candidates
172:                 .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
173:                 .OrderBy(c => c.width)
174:                 .FirstOrDefault();
175: 
176:             if (smallest.url != null)
177:                 filtered.Add(smallest);
178:         }
179: 
180:         return filtered.Count > 0
181:             ? string.Join(", ", filtered.Select(c =>
182:                 c.width.HasValue ? $"{c.url} {c.width}w" : c.url))
183:             : null;
184:     }
185: 
186:     private static string? BuildImgTag(
187:         string? src = "",
188:         string? width = "",
189:         string? height = "",
190:         string? alt = "",
191:         string? srcset = "",
192:         string? sizes = "")
193:     {
194:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(src))
195:             return null;
196: 
197:         alt ??= "Article image";
198: 
199:         // Clean and limit srcset
200:         srcset = CleanSrcsetForPreview(srcset);
201: 
202:         // Force safe sizes for card previews
203:         sizes = "(max-width: 576px) 100vw, (max-width: 992px) 80vw, 805px";
204: 
205:         var sb = new StringBuilder();
206: 
207:         var bestSrc = PickBestSrcFromSrcset(srcset) ?? src;
208: 
209:         sb.Append($"<img src=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(bestSrc)}\" ");
210: 
211:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(width))
212:         {
213:             sb.Append($"width=\"{width}\" ");
214:         }
215: 
216:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(height))
217:         {
218:             sb.Append($"height=\"{height}\" ");
219:         }
220: 
221:         sb.Append("class=\"img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3\" ");
222:         sb.Append($"alt=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(alt)}\" ");
223: 
224:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
225:         {
226:             sb.Append($"srcset=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(srcset)}\" ");
227:             sb.Append($"sizes=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(sizes)}\" ");
228:         }
229: 
230:         sb.Append("/>");
231:         return sb.ToString();
232:     }
233: 
234:     private static string? PickBestSrcFromSrcset(string? srcset, int targetWidth = 805)
235:     {
236:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
237:             return null;
238: 
239:         var matches = SrcsetCandidateRegex.Matches(srcset);
240: 
241:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int width)>();
242: 
243:         foreach (Match match in matches)
244:         {
245:             if (!match.Groups["w"].Success)
246:                 continue;
247: 
248:             if (int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
249:             {
250:                 var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
251:                 candidates.Add((url, w));
252:             }
253:         }
254: 
255:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
256:             return null;
257: 
258:         return candidates
259:             .OrderBy(c => Math.Abs(c.width - targetWidth))
260:             .First()
261:             .url;
262:     }
263: 
264:     private static int GetPreferredMaxWidth(List<(string url, int? width)> candidates)
265:     {
266:         var widths = candidates
267:             .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
268:             .Select(c => c.width!.Value)
269:             .OrderBy(w => w)
270:             .ToList();
271: 
272:         if (widths.Count == 0)
273:             return 805;
274: 
275:         bool hasPng = candidates.Any(c =>
276:             c.url.Contains(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
277: 
278:         // Ideal preview range
279:         int target = hasPng ? 600 : 805;
280: 
281:         // Pick closest available width ABOVE target (not below → avoid blur)
282:         var best = widths.FirstOrDefault(w => w >= target);
283: 
284:         if (best != 0)
285:             return best;
286: 
287:         // fallback → largest available (if all smaller)
288:         return widths.Last();
289:     }
290: 
291:     private string? AssignDefaultThumbnailImg(string feedUrl)
292:     {
293:         return DefaultThumbnailTags.ThumbnailMap.FirstOrDefault(p => feedUrl.Contains(p.Key)).Value
294:             ?? LogAndReturnNull();
295: 
296:         string? LogAndReturnNull()
297:         {
298:             _logger.LogWarning("Error: No default thumbnail image tag assigned!");
299:             return null;
300:         }
301:     }
302: }

File: PositiveNews.Web/Api/ArticlesApiController.cs

 1: using MediatR;
 2: using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.Queries.Articles;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs.Articles;
 5: using PositiveNews.Web.Api.Models;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Web.Api;
 8: 
 9: [ApiController]
10: [Route("api/articles")]
11: public sealed class ArticlesApiController(IMediator mediator) : ControllerBase
12: {
13:     [HttpGet("feed")]
14:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ArticleFeedResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
15:     public async Task<ActionResult<ArticleFeedResponse>> GetFeed(
16:         [FromQuery] int page = 1,
17:         [FromQuery] string? topic = null,
18:         CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
19:     {
20:         var result = await mediator.Send(new GetArticleFeedQuery(page, topic), cancellationToken);
21:         return Ok(MapFeed(result));
22:     }
23: 
24:     [HttpGet("{id:long}")]
25:     [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ArticleDetailResponse), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
26:     [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
27:     public async Task<ActionResult<ArticleDetailResponse>> GetById(long id, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
28:     {
29:         var article = await mediator.Send(new GetArticleDetailQuery(id), cancellationToken);
30:         if (article == null)
31:         {
32:             return NotFound();
33:         }
34: 
35:         return Ok(MapDetail(article));
36:     }
37: 
38:     private static ArticleFeedResponse MapFeed(ArticleFeedPageResult result)
39:     {
40:         return new ArticleFeedResponse
41:         {
42:             Articles = result.Articles.Select(a => new ArticlePreviewResponse
43:             {
44:                 Id = a.Id,
45:                 SourceName = a.SourceName,
46:                 SourceLogoUrl = a.SourceLogoUrl,
47:                 Title = a.Title,
48:                 Author = a.Author,
49:                 PublishedAt = a.PublishedAt,
50:                 ImageTag = a.ImageTag,
51:                 SummaryShort = a.SummaryShort,
52:                 Topics = a.Topics.ToList()
53:             }).ToList(),
54:             CurrentPage = result.CurrentPage,
55:             TotalPages = result.TotalPages,
56:             PageSize = result.PageSize,
57:             SelectedTopic = result.SelectedTopic
58:         };
59:     }
60: 
61:     private static ArticleDetailResponse MapDetail(ArticleDetailDto dto)
62:     {
63:         return new ArticleDetailResponse
64:         {
65:             Id = dto.Id,
66:             Title = dto.Title,
67:             SourceName = dto.SourceName,
68:             SourceLogoUrl = dto.SourceLogoUrl,
69:             Author = dto.Author,
70:             PublishedAt = dto.PublishedAt,
71:             ContentHtml = dto.ContentHtml
72:         };
73:     }
74: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/api/articles-api.ts
================
 1: import type { ArticleDetailResponse, ArticleFeedResponse } from './types'
 2: 
 3: const apiBase = (import.meta.env.VITE_API_BASE ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '')
 4: 
 5: function apiUrl(path: string) {
 6:   return `${apiBase}${path.startsWith('/') ? '' : '/'}${path}`
 7: }
 8: 
 9: export async function fetchArticleFeed(page: number, topic: string | null): Promise<ArticleFeedResponse> {
10:   const params = new URLSearchParams()
11:   params.set('page', String(page))
12:   if (topic) {
13:     params.set('topic', topic)
14:   }
15: 
16:   const res = await fetch(apiUrl(`/api/articles/feed?${params.toString()}`), {
17:     headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
18:   })
19: 
20:   if (!res.ok) {
21:     throw new Error(`Feed request failed (${res.status})`)
22:   }
23: 
24:   return res.json() as Promise<ArticleFeedResponse>
25: }
26: 
27: export async function fetchArticleDetail(id: number): Promise<ArticleDetailResponse | null> {
28:   const res = await fetch(apiUrl(`/api/articles/${id}`), {
29:     headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
30:   })
31: 
32:   if (res.status === 404) {
33:     return null
34:   }
35: 
36:   if (!res.ok) {
37:     throw new Error(`Article request failed (${res.status})`)
38:   }
39: 
40:   return res.json() as Promise<ArticleDetailResponse>
41: }

File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/components/ArticleCard.tsx

 1: import { useState } from 'react'
 2: import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
 3: import type { ArticlePreviewResponse } from '../api/types'
 4: import { ArticleImage } from './ArticleImage'
 5: import { ArticleTopicLinks } from './ArticleTopicLinks'
 6: 
 7: function formatPublishedAt(iso: string) {
 8:     const d = new Date(iso)
 9:     return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })
10: }
11: 
12: type ArticleCardProps = {
13:     article: ArticlePreviewResponse
14:     index: number
15:     selectedTopic: string | null | undefined
16: }
17: 
18: export function ArticleCard({ article, index, selectedTopic }: ArticleCardProps) {
19:     const [summaryOpen, setSummaryOpen] = useState(false)
20:     const hasPreviewImage = Boolean(article.imageTag?.trim())
21: 
22:     return (
23:         <div className="card mb-4 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
24:             <div
25:                 className={`article-card-layout ${!hasPreviewImage ? 'article-card-layout--no-image' : ''}`}
26:             >
27:                 <div className="article-card-hdr card-header bg-white flex-column align-items-start border-0 pb-0">
28:                     {article.sourceLogoUrl ? (
29:                         <img
30:                             src={article.sourceLogoUrl}
31:                             alt={article.sourceName}
32:                             className="me-2"
33:                             style={{ width: 32, height: 32, objectFit: 'cover' }}
34:                         />
35:                     ) : null}
36:                     <span className="fw-bold text-muted fs-5">{article.sourceName}</span>
37:                     <h6 className="card-subtitle pt-2 mb-0 text-muted">
38:                         {(article.author?.trim().length ? article.author : 'Unknown Author') + ' • ' + formatPublishedAt(article.publishedAt)}
39:                         </h6>
40:                 </div>
41:                 <div className="article-card-title card-body">
42:                     <h4 className="card-title fw-bold">{article.title}</h4>
43:                 </div>
44: 
45:                 {hasPreviewImage ? (
46:                     <div className="article-card-image">
47:                         <ArticleImage imageTag={article.imageTag} index={index} />
48:                     </div>
49:                 ) : null}
50: 
51:                 <div className="article-card-body card-body pt-0 border-0">
52:                     <ArticleTopicLinks topics={article.topics} selectedTopic={selectedTopic} />
53: 
54:                     <div className="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-2">
55:                         <button type="button" className="btn btn-outline-secondary" onClick={() => setSummaryOpen((o) => !o)}>
56:                             {summaryOpen ? 'Hide summary' : 'Show summary'}
57:                         </button>
58: 
59:                         <Link to={`/articles/${article.id}`} className="btn btn-primary">
60:                             Read article
61:                         </Link>
62:                     </div>
63: 
64:                     <div className={`mt-3 bg-light rounded ${summaryOpen ? '' : 'd-none'}`}>
65:                         <strong>Summary:</strong>
66:                         <p className="mb-0">{article.summaryShort}</p>
67:                     </div>
68:                 </div>
69:             </div>
70:         </div>
71:     )
72: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/components/ArticleImage.tsx
================
 1: type ArticleImageProps = {
 2:   imageTag: string | null | undefined
 3:   index: number
 4: }
 5: 
 6: /**
 7:  * Mirrors the legacy <article-img /> tag helper: extracts the first <img> from stored HTML
 8:  * and applies loading/decoding hints without altering other attributes.
 9:  */
10: export function ArticleImage({ imageTag, index }: ArticleImageProps) {
11:   if (!imageTag?.trim()) {
12:     return null
13:   }
14: 
15:   const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(imageTag, 'text/html')
16:   const img = doc.querySelector('img')
17:   if (!img) {
18:     return null
19:   }
20: 
21:   const loading = index < 2 ? 'eager' : 'lazy'
22:   const decoding = index < 2 ? 'sync' : 'async'
23:   img.setAttribute('loading', loading)
24:   img.setAttribute('decoding', decoding)
25: 
26:   return <span className="d-inline-block" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: img.outerHTML }} />
27: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/components/ArticleTopicLinks.tsx
================
 1: import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'
 2: 
 3: type ArticleTopicLinksProps = {
 4:   topics: string[]
 5:   selectedTopic: string | null | undefined
 6: }
 7: 
 8: export function ArticleTopicLinks({ topics, selectedTopic }: ArticleTopicLinksProps) {
 9:   const distinct = [...new Set(topics ?? [])].filter((t) => t.trim().length > 0)
10:   if (distinct.length === 0) {
11:     return null
12:   }
13: 
14:   return (
15:     <div className="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-2">
16:       {distinct.map((topic) => {
17:         const isActive =
18:           selectedTopic != null && topic.toLowerCase() === selectedTopic.toLowerCase()
19:         const btnClass = isActive ? 'btn btn-primary btn-sm' : 'btn btn-outline-dark btn-sm'
20:         const qs = new URLSearchParams({ topic, page: '1' })
21: 
22:         return (
23:           <Link key={topic} to={`/?${qs.toString()}`} className={btnClass} style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
24:             {topic}
25:           </Link>
26:         )
27:       })}
28:     </div>

File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx
================
  1: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
  2: import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'
  3: import { fetchArticleDetail } from '../api/articles-api'
  4: import type { ArticleDetailResponse } from '../api/types'
  5: 
  6: function formatDetailDate(iso: string) {
  7:   const d = new Date(iso)
  8:   return d.toLocaleString(undefined, { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })
  9: }
 10: 
 11: export function ArticleDetailPage() {
 12:   const { id } = useParams()
 13:   const numericId = Number(id)
 14: 
 15:   const [article, setArticle] = useState<ArticleDetailResponse | null | undefined>(undefined)
 16:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
 17: 
 18:   useEffect(() => {
 19:     if (!Number.isFinite(numericId)) {
 20:       setArticle(null)
 21:       return
 22:     }
 23: 
 24:     let cancelled = false
 25:     setError(null)
 26: 
 27:     ;(async () => {
 28:       try {
 29:         const res = await fetchArticleDetail(numericId)
 30:         if (!cancelled) {
 31:           setArticle(res)
 32:         }
 33:       } catch (e) {
 34:         if (!cancelled) {
 35:           setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load article')
 36:           setArticle(null)
 37:         }
 38:       }
 39:     })()
 40: 
 41:     return () => {
 42:       cancelled = true
 43:     }
 44:   }, [numericId])
 45: 
 46:   useEffect(() => {
 47:     if (article?.title) {
 48:       document.title = `${article.title} - PositiveNews.Web`
 49:     }
 50:   }, [article?.title])
 51: 
 52:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericId)) {
 53:     return (
 54:       <main className="mt-4 mb-5">
 55:         <div className="alert alert-warning">Invalid article id.</div>
 56:       </main>
 57:     )
 58:   }
 59: 
 60:   if (error) {
 61:     return (
 62:       <main className="mt-4 mb-5">
 63:         <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>
 64:       </main>
 65:     )
 66:   }
 67: 
 68:   if (article === undefined) {
 69:     return (
 70:       <main className="mt-4 mb-5">
 71:         <div className="alert alert-secondary mb-0">Loading…</div>
 72:       </main>
 73:     )
 74:   }
 75: 
 76:   if (article === null) {
 77:     return (
 78:       <main className="mt-4 mb-5">
 79:         <div className="alert alert-warning">Article not found.</div>
 80:       </main>
 81:     )
 82:   }
 83: 
 84:   return (
 85:     <main className="mt-4 mb-5">
 86:       <div className="row justify-content-center">
 87:         <div className="col-md-12">
 88:           <div className="d-flex justify-content-between">
 89:             <Link to="/" className="text-decoration-none mb-4 d-inline-block">
 90:               &larr; Back to Feed
 91:             </Link>
 92:             <div>
 93:               {article.sourceLogoUrl ? (
 94:                 <img
 95:                   src={article.sourceLogoUrl}
 96:                   alt={article.sourceName}
 97:                   className="border-light me-2"
 98:                   style={{ width: 32, height: 32, objectFit: 'cover' }}
 99:                 />
100:               ) : null}
101:               <span className="fw-bold me-2">{article.sourceName}</span>
102:             </div>
103:           </div>
104: 
105:           <h1 className="fw-bold mb-3">{article.title}</h1>
106: 
107:           <div className="d-flex align-items-center text-muted mb-4 border-bottom pb-3">
108:             <span>•</span>
109:             <span className="mx-2">{article.author?.trim().length ? article.author : 'Unknown Author'}</span>
110:             <span>•</span>
111:             <span className="ms-2">{formatDetailDate(article.publishedAt)}</span>
112:           </div>
113: 
114:           {article.contentHtml?.trim() ? (
115:             <div
116:               className="article-content fs-5"
117:               style={{ lineHeight: 1.8 }}
118:               dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: article.contentHtml }}
119:             />
120:           ) : (
121:             <div className="alert alert-warning">Full content is not available for this article yet.</div>
122:           )}
123:         </div>
124:       </div>
125:     </main>
126:   )
127: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Web/ClientApp/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx
================
  1: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
  2: import { Link, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom'
  3: import { fetchArticleFeed } from '../api/articles-api'
  4: import type { ArticleFeedResponse } from '../api/types'
  5: import { ArticleCard } from '../components/ArticleCard'
  6: 
  7: function parsePage(raw: string | null) {
  8:   const n = Number(raw ?? '1')
  9:   if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 1) {
 10:     return 1
 11:   }
 12:   return Math.floor(n)
 13: }
 14: 
 15: export function FeedPage() {
 16:   const [searchParams, setSearchParams] = useSearchParams()
 17:   const page = useMemo(() => parsePage(searchParams.get('page')), [searchParams])
 18:   const topic = useMemo(() => {
 19:     const t = searchParams.get('topic')
 20:     return t && t.trim().length > 0 ? t.trim() : null
 21:   }, [searchParams])
 22: 
 23:   const [data, setData] = useState<ArticleFeedResponse | null>(null)
 24:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
 25: 
 26:   useEffect(() => {
 27:     let cancelled = false
 28:     setError(null)
 29: 
 30:     ;(async () => {
 31:       try {
 32:         const res = await fetchArticleFeed(page, topic)
 33:         if (!cancelled) {
 34:           setData(res)
 35:         }
 36:       } catch (e) {
 37:         if (!cancelled) {
 38:           setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to load feed')
 39:         }
 40:       }
 41:     })()
 42: 
 43:     return () => {
 44:       cancelled = true
 45:     }
 46:   }, [page, topic])
 47: 
 48:   const title =
 49:     topic == null || topic.length === 0 ? 'Latest News' : `Topic: ${topic}`
 50: 
 51:   const documentTitle =
 52:     topic == null || topic.length === 0 ? 'Positive News Feed' : `Articles - ${topic}`
 53: 
 54:   useEffect(() => {
 55:     document.title = `${documentTitle} - PositiveNews.Web`
 56:   }, [documentTitle])
 57: 
 58:   if (error) {
 59:     return (
 60:       <main role="main" className="pb-3 mt-4">
 61:         <div className="alert alert-danger">{error}</div>
 62:       </main>
 63:     )
 64:   }
 65: 
 66:   if (!data) {
 67:     return (
 68:       <main role="main" className="pb-3 mt-4">
 69:         <div className="alert alert-secondary mb-0">Loading…</div>
 70:       </main>
 71:     )
 72:   }
 73: 
 74:   function setPage(nextPage: number) {
 75:     const next = new URLSearchParams(searchParams)
 76:     next.set('page', String(nextPage))
 77:     if (topic) {
 78:       next.set('topic', topic)
 79:     } else {
 80:       next.delete('topic')
 81:     }
 82:     setSearchParams(next)
 83:   }
 84: 
 85:   return (
 86:     <main role="main" className="pb-2 mt-1">
 87:       <div className="row justify-content-center">
 88:         <div className="col-md-12">
 89:           <div className="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-1">
 90:             <h3>{title}</h3>
 91:             {topic ? (
 92:               <Link to="/" className="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
 93:                 ✕ Clear Filter
 94:               </Link>
 95:             ) : null}
 96:           </div>
 97: 
 98:           {topic ? (
 99:             <div className="alert alert-info mb-4">
100:               Showing articles with topic <strong>{topic}</strong> first.
101:             </div>
102:           ) : null}
103: 
104:           {data.articles.map((a, i) => (
105:             <ArticleCard key={a.id} article={a} index={i} selectedTopic={data.selectedTopic ?? topic} />
106:           ))}
107: 
108:           {data.totalPages > 1 ? (
109:             <nav>
110:               <ul className="pagination justify-content-center">
111:                 <li className={`page-item ${data.currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''}`}>
112:                   <button
113:                     type="button"
114:                     className="page-link"
115:                     disabled={data.currentPage === 1}
116:                     onClick={() => setPage(data.currentPage - 1)}
117:                   >
118:                     Previous
119:                   </button>
120:                 </li>
121: 
122:                 <li className="page-item disabled">
123:                   <span className="page-link">
124:                     Page {data.currentPage} of {data.totalPages}
125:                   </span>
126:                 </li>
127: 
128:                 <li className={`page-item ${data.currentPage === data.totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''}`}>
129:                   <button
130:                     type="button"
131:                     className="page-link"
132:                     disabled={data.currentPage === data.totalPages}
133:                     onClick={() => setPage(data.currentPage + 1)}
134:                   >
135:                     Next
136:                   </button>
137:                 </li>
138:               </ul>
139:             </nav>
140:           ) : null}
141:         </div>
142:       </div>
143:     </main>
144:   )
145: }

================
File: PositiveNews.Web/Program.cs
================
 1: using Serilog;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application;
 3: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure;
 4: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seeding;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Web;
 7: 
 8: public class Program
 9: {
10:     public static async Task Main(string[] args)
11:     {
12:         Log.Logger = new LoggerConfiguration()
13:             .WriteTo.Console()
14:             .WriteTo.File(
15:                 path: "logs/positivenews-.log",
16:                 rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
17:                 retainedFileCountLimit: 30,
18:                 outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} [{Level:u3}] {SourceContext}: {Message:lj}{NewLine}{Exception}")
19:             .CreateBootstrapLogger();
20: 
21:         try
22:         {
23:             Log.Information("Starting PositiveNews Web (API + SPA)...");
24: 
25:             var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
26: 
27:             builder.Host.UseSerilog((context, loggerConfig) =>
28:             {
29:                 loggerConfig
30:                     .ReadFrom.Configuration(context.Configuration)
31:                     .Enrich.FromLogContext()
32:                     .WriteTo.Console()
33:                     .WriteTo.File(
34:                         path: "logs/positivenews-.log",
35:                         rollingInterval: RollingInterval.Day,
36:                         retainedFileCountLimit: 30,
37:                         outputTemplate: "{Timestamp:yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff zzz} [{Level:u3}] {SourceContext}: {Message:lj}{NewLine}{Exception}");
38:             });
39: 
40:             builder.Services.AddApplicationServices();
41:             builder.Services.AddInfrastructureServices(builder.Configuration);
42:             builder.Services.AddControllers();
43: 
44:             var app = builder.Build();
45: 
46:             await DataSeeder.SeedAsync(app.Services);
47: 
48:             if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
49:             {
50:                 app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage();
51:             }
52:             else
53:             {
54:                 app.UseExceptionHandler(errorApp =>
55:                 {
56:                     errorApp.Run(async context =>
57:                     {
58:                         context.Response.StatusCode = StatusCodes.Status500InternalServerError;
59:                         context.Response.ContentType = "text/plain";
60:                         await context.Response.WriteAsync("An unexpected error occurred.");
61:                     });
62:                 });
63:                 app.UseHsts();
64:             }
65: 
66:             app.UseSerilogRequestLogging();
67:             app.UseHttpsRedirection();
68: 
69:             var defaultFiles = new DefaultFilesOptions();
70:             defaultFiles.DefaultFileNames.Clear();
71:             defaultFiles.DefaultFileNames.Add("index.html");
72:             app.UseDefaultFiles(defaultFiles);
73:             app.UseStaticFiles();
74: 
75:             app.UseRouting();
76:             app.UseAuthorization();
77: 
78:             app.MapControllers();
79:             app.MapFallbackToFile("index.html");
80: 
81:             await app.RunAsync();
82:         }
83:         catch (Exception ex)
84:         {
85:             Log.Fatal(ex, "Application terminated unexpectedly.");
86:         }
87:         finally
88:         {
89:             await Log.CloseAndFlushAsync();
90:         }
91:     }
92: }
